name: Muha Meds Disposable (3rd Gen) | Dragon Berry Runtz
description: Dragon Berry Runtz hits with candy-dripped berry vibes and a smooth finish that’ll have you sinking into the couch. This indica leans hazy and heavy in the best way, bringing on that melt-into-the-night chill. Sweet, juicy, and dreamy AF.
